description: Starter Environment Kits admitted in 'biotech' (MO-12, ADR-0042): envkit.python-uv@1, envkit.node@1, envkit.python-uv-node@1, envkit.mission-control-dev@1, envkit.knowledge-research@1, envkit.biotech-backend@1. Each row inlines its mc.environment_kit.v1 manifest; bytes live in the capability-bundles bucket under the manifest's digest path (upload with scripts/seeds_publish_bundles.py). Rows use the existing 'profile' asset category and the 0031 host-support profiles; no migration is required.

definition.description: This repository: uv with the biotech and dbcontract groups, make, and Docker Compose for the services (application PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector, Redis, Temporal 1.31 with its admin-tools CLI image); PostgreSQL and Temporal run as those pinned images, not as host toolchains. Its base layer is the Mission Control-owned .cursor/environment.json, Dockerfile and scripts (DECISIONS R24).
